Manchester United v Crystal Palace (Kick-off 12.45pm). Coverage of the match at Progress with Unity Stadium. Tottenham Hotspur v Everton (Kick-off 3.00pm). Coverage of the match at BetWright Stadium. Goals in each half from Yuka Momiki and Kelly Gago secured the points in a 2-1 win for the Toffees when these teams met in the corresponding clash at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium last season, while Signe Gaupset had bagged a second-half equaliser for the hosts.

Brighton \u0026 Hove Albion v Liverpool (Kick-off 5.15pm). Coverage of the match at American Express Stadium. A 0-0 draw was the end result when the Seagulls welcomed the Reds to Broadfield Stadium last season, which at the time extended the hosts' winless run to four matches, while Liverpool failed in their attempts to win back-to-back matches for the first time in that campaign, but did move five points clear of bottom of the table Leicester City.
